text: Go to Cookie Road to find the sweets ingredients\nrequested by Filecia!
Lefina and Filecia starts battling with their sweets that\nhave been turned into monsters. Team up with Filecia to\ndefeat Lefina's sweets monster!
You have decided to team up with Lefina, however,\nPelulu chooses to side with Filecia.\nWin the battle against these formidable opponents!
Finally you stop the monsters.\nDo your best to soothe Lefina and Filecia!
